articles.title: Alsobrooks says Clarity Act needs ethics deal before Senate vote
articles.snippet: The Maryland Democrat says bipartisan crypto legislation is close, but ethics and illicit finance concerns remain unresolved.

articles.title: Crypto Clarity Act in spotlight for bad-actor provisions as Senate process grinds forward
articles.snippet: The industry has been trying to make a case this week the Clarity Act provides law enforcement strong tools to combat illicit finance involving cryptocurrency.

articles.title: Crypto for Advisors: The crypto due diligence questions you forgot to ask
articles.snippet: As stablecoins, shifting regulation and AI-enabled infrastructure mature, advisors should revisit three questions their crypto due diligence may no longer fully cover.

articles.title: Senate Republicans push finance watchdogs to clarify crypto capital rules
articles.snippet: Senator Cynthia Lummis has led a group of lawmakers urging financial regulators for “fair capital treatment for on-balance sheet treatment of digital assets.”

articles.title: Russia targets British 17-year-old for alleging digital assets were skirting sanctions
articles.snippet: Political activist Bill Browder, the teenager’s father, said his son was “the first high school student in the world to be sanctioned by an authoritarian regime” over a report on the ruble-pegged stablecoin A7A5.
